01 — Profile

About

I'm a Computer Science engineer who works at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and applied AI. My focus is building systems that stay reliable in production — serverless functions on AWS Lambda, compute on EC2, and data pipelines that end in a QuickSight dashboard someone can actually act on.

On the data science side, I work through the full loop: cleaning and exploring data in Python, building and evaluating models, and wiring search and retrieval systems so answers are fast and relevant. I've been extending that with generative AI tooling built around Claude, using it to prototype and automate parts of the engineering workflow itself.

I graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (2021–2025) from Narina College of Engineering and Technology, and hold certifications from IIT Kanpur in Python and Java alongside the AWS AI Partner certification.
